issue.title: Cold import of sase.history.prompt_store_mutations raises circular ImportError and breaks LaunchApproval dispatch
issue.description:
Proposed by epic phase sase-1gu.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2); triaged by the sase-1gu land agent. Not caused by epic sase-1gu: the causal commit ad7f3a19a3 belongs to the closed epic sase-1d8.

Independent reproduction by the sase-1gu land agent on 2026-10-06 at origin/master 17c7f66bb3: `.venv/bin/python -c "import sase.history.prompt_store_mutations"` still raises the ImportError. Importing `sase.history.prompt_store` first succeeds.

task_type_fields.impact: LaunchApproval dispatch is broken whenever the dispatching process has not already imported `sase.history.prompt_store`. LaunchApproval launch-ac9ca583-8595-4bc8-90cd-42b631170bbe was answered Approve but dispatch_status=failed with this ImportError, so the approved agents never launched. That blocked the E1 (sase-1gu) acceptance probes requested through /sase_run. Any /sase_run or bead-work launch that reaches these lazy imports in a cold process can fail the same way.
task_type_fields.repro:
Run from a sase checkout at origin/master 17c7f66bb3:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -c "import sase.history.prompt_store_mutations"
```

Result: `ImportError: cannot import name 'add_or_update_prompt' from partially initialized module 'sase.history.prompt_store_mutations' (most likely due to a circular import)`.

Root cause: `src/sase/history/prompt_store_mutations.py` line 9 does `from sase.history import prompt_store as store`, and the bottom of `src/sase/history/prompt_store.py` (line ~477) does `from sase.history.prompt_store_mutations import add_or_update_prompt, record_failed_launch_prompt, rewrite_prompt_text_exact`. If `prompt_store` is imported first, everything works. If `prompt_store_mutations` is imported first, `prompt_store` runs its trailing import against a half-built mutations module and fails. The lazy callers `src/sase/agent/launch_cwd_agents.py:67` and `src/sase/agent/launch_cwd_bead_work.py:72` do `from sase.history.prompt_store_mutations import effective_prompt_origin`. They were added in ad7f3a19a3 (2026-09-30, sase-1d8.1). In any process that has not already imported `prompt_store`, those calls hit the failing import order.

Fix direction: make the import order-independent, either by having the mutations module avoid the eager facade import at module load or by having the lazy callers import through `sase.history.prompt_store` first. Then add a regression test that imports `sase.history.prompt_store_mutations` in a fresh interpreter (subprocess) and launches through `launch_cwd_agents`.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1gu.6 acceptance phase saw an approved LaunchApproval fail at dispatch with this circular ImportError. The sase-1gu land agent reproduced it independently at master HEAD, and no existing task tracks it.
